content.rendered:
When Bruce took the stage in South Africa for the first time ever, we knew we were in for something special right from the beginning.

From the High Hopes Tour opening show on January 26, 2014, here’s a wonderful pro-shot video of Bruce’s opening number: a cover of “Free Nelson Mandela” by The Special A.K.A.

Never charting in the U.S., “Free Nelson Mandela” reached #9 in the UK in its original 1984 release and was massively popular across Africa. When Mandela passed away in December 2013, the song charted once again, reaching #96–so when Bruce performed it at three South Africa shows in late January 2014, it was very timely.

Free Nelson Mandela
First performed: January 26, 2014 (Cape Town, South Africa)
Last performed: February 1, 2014 (Johannesburg, South Africa)

© July 10, 2018

excerpt.rendered: When Bruce stepped on a South African stage for the first time, he opened with this faithful cover of The Special AKA’s protest song, “Free Nelson Mandela.” Watch that pro-shot performance inside.

jetpack-related-posts.title: Don’t Change
jetpack-related-posts.author: Ken
jetpack-related-posts.excerpt: When Bruce and the E Street Band visited INXS's home town of Sydney in 2014, they paid tribute with one of their very best modern covers.

jetpack-related-posts.title: Cover Me: Just Like Fire Would
jetpack-related-posts.author: Ken
jetpack-related-posts.excerpt: A one-off cover for local flavor turned rare studio cover, The Saints' "Just Like Fire Would" is a natural fit for Bruce's set lists.

jetpack-related-posts.title: Precious Memories
jetpack-related-posts.author: Ken
jetpack-related-posts.excerpt: Sometime in late 1981, Bruce sat down with a tape recorder and attempted a cover of "Precious Memories." Listen to that demo here.

jetpack-related-posts.title: Brown Eyed Girl
jetpack-related-posts.author: Ken
jetpack-related-posts.excerpt: Bruce doesn't play "Brown Eyed Girl" often, but when he does, it's a singalong highlight, with no teleprompter required.

jetpack-related-posts.title: Do You Remember Rock’n’Roll Radio
jetpack-related-posts.author: Ken
jetpack-related-posts.excerpt: A one-time-only cover of a Ramones classic.

jetpack-related-posts.title: Needles and Pins
jetpack-related-posts.author: Ken
jetpack-related-posts.excerpt: Never performed but occasionally soundchecked, Bruce was clearly taken with The Searchers’ “Needles and Pins” during the Born to Run tour.
